import seaborn as sns

sns.barplot(x=product_revenue.values, y=product_revenue.index, palette="viridis")
plt.title("Total Revenue by Product")
plt.xlabel("Total Revenue ($)")
plt.ylabel("Product")
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the plot
plt.savefig("output.png")
